items.title: GTA VI: Why the 13-year wait could be worth $8 billion
items.summary: After more than 13 years, Grand Theft Auto VI finally launches on November 19, and it's about a lot more than a video game. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian follows the money: why Take-Two is telling investors to expect $8 billion-plus in bookings this year but only about $109 million to $142 million in profit, how GTA Online's recurring spending became the real prize, and why Sony and Microsoft can cash in without making the game at all.

items.title: Josh Brown Says Netflix Trades at 16 Times Next Year’s Earnings After a 50% Drop. Is It a Buy?
items.summary: Josh Brown once called Netflix his biggest mistake of the year, then watched the stock sink even further. Now he sees a bargain hiding in the wreckage, but the bear case has real teeth, and one upcoming report could settle the debate.

items.title: Disney Rises 5% as 10 Analysts Raise Targets on Earnings Beat and $3 Billion Savings Plan
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDisney stock jumped 5% today after 10 firms raised their targets to between $130 and $143 on a fiscal fourth-quarter beat and a $3 billion savings plan. The new targets ask for little more than today’s multiple on fiscal 2028 earnings estimates.
